python3 - <<"PY"
from pathlib import Path
p=Path("index.html")
s=p.read_text()
start=s.index("<div class=\"email-field\">")
end=s.index("<dl class=\"costs\"",start)
email=s[start:end]
s=s[:start]+s[end:]
pos=s.index("</dl>",start)+len("</dl>")
s=s[:pos]+email+s[pos:]
p.write_text(s)
PY
node checks/reservation.cjs; git diff --check; sha256sum versions/00.html index.html
